experiment_contract.algorithm_object: Executed raw BAOAB O stages, actual diffusion factors, Gaussian/uniform laws and addressed innovation shifts
experiment_contract.exact_identity: Conditional kinetic mean and variance follow from v_plus=c v+s B(xi+shift); uniform fourth moment9/5 changes energy variance. Predictable variances add for sequential martingale differences.
experiment_contract.execution_contract: Run through the shared Rust LectureSession; preserve full configuration, seed, trajectory evidence, observable normalization and required continuation checkpoints. No standalone supplied dynamics generates lecture observations.
experiment_contract.limitations: Predictable variation is a fluctuation scale, not an exact confidence band. Programmed B=sqrt(2gamma T)g_inverse_sqrt determines noise geometry; measured raw increments independently test its consequence.
experiment_contract.measurement: Measures raw velocity increments and computes source-aware conditional moments from recorded B and law. Cumulative centered energy compared with square-root predictable variation.
experiment_contract.title: Conditional BAOAB diffusion and heating

validation.method: Predictions use source-aware analytic conditional moments at each actual stage. Independent full-run seeds are the sampling units. The standardized sums are diagnostics, not exact Gaussian p-values.

details.parameters_source: integrator and actual noise records; reference fixture controls do not alter archive predictions
details.sampling_unit: sequential O-stage martingale differences; no independent-walker or independent-step sampling assumption
details.uncertainty: Predictable quadratic variation is the sum of conditional energy variances. Its realized square root is a fluctuation scale, not an exact finite-sample confidence band.

model: Raw O-stage observations and predictions from each executed diffusion factor and declared innovation law
notes: The metric-dependent factor is a programmed input to the update. Its conditional heating prediction is independently checked by the recorded velocity increment. Boundaries, kicks and clone transfers are excluded from this raw O-stage quantity.
